player_prompt.intro:
Ame nye Aʋa {player_id} ({piece}). Aʋakɔ nye ({opp}).
Dze agbagba kɔkɔe be '[a2 a3]' (tso → yi).
- Agbagba sɔsɔe nye agbagba ɖeka kple dzegɔme kple afɔku ƒe nɔnɔme.
- Agbagba xɔxɔe nye agbagba ɖeka kple dzegɔme kple afɔku ƒe nɔnɔme, eye wòasrɔ yi afɔku si le eme.
Agbagba xɔxɔe ɖeka ƒe akɔnta nye {score_per_capture} akɔnta.
Agbagba si wu le {max_moves} agbagba kple agbagba si aʋa meɖe o.

invalid_move.unknown_square: Ame si womenya o ƒe ablɔ.
invalid_move.not_your_piece: Menye wò dɔe nye be nànya afisi woxɔa nyatakakawo le o.
invalid_move.dest_not_empty: Mɔ si woɖo la mele ƒuƒlu o.
invalid_move.illegal: Enye afɔɖeɖe si mele se nu o.

outcome.move_limit: Woɖo woƒe ʋɔtruwo ƒe liƒo dzi.
